summary: Path-to-jobs map in .agentic/ci-path-jobs.yml (or .plate ci.path_jobs) plus select_ci_jobs helper and composite action with fail-closed selection and scheduled full-suite guidance.
migration_impact: Optional: adopters enable path selection by adding config and wiring plate-select-ci-jobs; required checks labels, test, and pr-gates stay unchanged with an aggregate test job pattern.
migration_guidance: 1. Copy .agentic/ci-path-jobs.example.yml to .agentic/ci-path-jobs.yml and set enabled: true with your modules and all_jobs list.
2. Add a select job using .github/actions/plate-select-ci-jobs; gate optional jobs with jobs_json / run_all outputs.
3. Keep job ids labels, test (aggregate), and pr-gates for branch protection; optional jobs may skip but aggregate test must pass.
4. Add plate-ci-scheduled-full-suite.example.yml (or equivalent) on main with full-suite: true for nightly coverage.
agent_notes: Regression: tests/test_ci_path_jobs.py. Helper exits 1 on safety fail. PLATE_CI_FULL_SUITE or --full-suite selects all jobs. Credits in docs/migration/ci-path-job-selection.md.
